description: Create a NEW macro from the given Ui.Vision JSON and save it in the "AI Generated" folder under a new, unique name. PREFER the JS script form {"Name": "...", "Script": "<JavaScript using the uiv.* API>"} over the classic Commands table — scripts are modern JS with real control flow and are the recommended way to build macros. Call get_authoring_guide for the uiv.* API before writing your first script. The new macro opens in the editor — refine it afterwards with set_macro. Returns the final macro name.

macro_json.description: The complete macro as a Ui.Vision JSON string, including a descriptive Name.

why.description: One short sentence shown in the Ui.Vision log: what this call does and why.

name: create_macro
